audit.state_definition: Mature reputation x in [0,1]; Beta(1+x/(1-rho),1+(1-x)/(1-rho)); only the selected seller updates.

demand.interpretation: Order doubling over the whole grid and independent adaptive quadrature at selected nodes; observed errors are diagnostics, not rigorous global error bounds. Direct Beta-draw selection matches the numerical kernel up to demand integration error.

audit.provenance_note: Current files are hashed separately from the historical solver hashes saved in each source manifest. Loaded policies and stationary laws are checked under the current actual-game kernel; no equilibrium solver was run.

metadata.random_generator: numpy.random.PCG64; independent SeedSequence child per replication
metadata.common_random_numbers: Same five uniforms per replication/time in every profile and mode
metadata.selection: Independent actual Beta posterior draws; A iff theta_A > theta_B, ties B
metadata.transition: Solver stochastic interpolation; selection matches finite kernel up to audited demand quadrature error
metadata.policy_extension: Stored probabilities at grid nodes; mixed choices sampled without thresholding

transient_validation.method: Repeated sparse propagation q_(t+1)=P.T @ q_t; expected pre-selection window law=sum(q_t)/length.
transient_validation.numerical_scope: Existing finite-grid transition matrices; selection integration error is documented in the original input audit. These are deterministic expectations, not Monte Carlo estimates or continuous-state equilibrium claims.
